description: Type insertFutureReservations' HTTP 412 PRECONDITION_FAILED ('Based on your service usage history, you are not eligible for using the Future Reservations feature at this time.', reason conditionNotMet). Future reservations are gated on account history; 412 is outside the default 4xx set, so it surfaced as UnknownGCPError. No smithy.api#httpError is set so it carries no retryable category. Observed live 2026-09-28 inserting a DRAFT future reservation in us-central1-a.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The project is not eligible for the Future Reservations feature (HTTP 412 conditionNotMet: 'Based on your service usage history, you are not eligible for using the Future Reservations feature at this time.'). Not retryable.

message.includes: not eligible for using the Future Reservations feature
